activateDesertMode().details: Desert mode must be entered in case of current L1 block timestamp is higher than the oldest priority request expiration timestamp

returns._0: bool Flag that is true if the desert mode must be entered

params._n: Number of outstanding priority requests to be cancelled
params._priorityPubData: Array of outstanding priority requests to be cancelled

params._price_decimals: [metadata] Number of decimals to represent price of an order in the order book
params._size_decimals: [metadata] Number of decimals to represent size of an order in the order book

params._isAsk: Flag to indicate if the order is ask or bid

params._accountIndex: Array of account index values, will be used in the future

params.batches: Array of batches that contains the on chain operations to be executed
params.onChainOperationsPubData: Array of on chain operations that are verified and to be executed

params._accountIndex: Account index of the user who is performing the desert exit
params._assetIndex: Asset index of the asset to be exited
params._l1Address: L1 address of the user who is performing the desert exit
params._totalBaseAmount: Total base balance of the user for the asset to be exited

params._l1Decimals: Number of decimals of the asset on L1
params._l2Decimals: Number of decimals of the asset on L2
params._priceDecimals: Number of decimals for the price of the asset
